risks.risk: Functionality not proven (could have shutter/AF/IBIS/controls issues).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a moving subject, take 5 photos, and show them on playback with no errors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven/assume worst-case typical used DSLR issues (i.e., treat as needing testing).

risks.risk: Shutter count claim may be false or unknown.
risks.proof: Ask for a screenshot/photo of shutter count from a reliable method (camera info + external shutter count tool output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher shutter count / unknown wear.

risks.risk: Lens condition (fungus/haze/scratches) not clearly verifiable from these angles.

risks.if_unproven: Price as lens condition not guaranteed (assume possible minor wear).

risks.risk: Visible scuffs/marks on camera body could indicate rough handling or drops.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the camera body corners, mount area, and any dents/scratches.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for used condition.
